source: PA-GEO-04's development labels and PA-GEO-05's held-out labels, both as committed, re-read under definitions version 2 with every change recorded below. PA-GEO-05's held-out sample is spent; its records are development data for matcher v2.
labeller: AI model instances (Claude). The conversions below are the matcher designer's reading of the definitions, not a blind relabelling.

records.note: C5 way/194225555 (Iron Horse Trail cycleway/path) follows the whole 304 m record at a median 0.6 m and is about the same length; the other City records on it are junction stubs of under 5 m, so they are not counted.
The Iron Horse Trail: OSM cycleway C1 (foot=designated) lies within 1 m along the whole record. GEO-03 counted it as not along an OSM pedestrian way only because its filter excluded highway=cycleway.
OSM path bridge (bridge=yes, surface=wood) within 1.4 m; 19.9 m against 20.1 m.
OSM path bridge (bridge=yes, surface=wood) within 1.1 m; 31.2 m against 29.6 m.

OSM has a bridge footway, C4 way/364837704 (bridge=yes, layer=1), at a median 0.23 m and almost the same length (17.5 m vs 19.3 m). C2 and C3 only touch the ends, and C4 carries no other City record, so one_to_one.

OSM path C8 way/738089022 (highway=path, tunnel=yes) runs through the Fischer-Hallman underpass 0.4-1.1 m from the whole record; the road and bridge sidewalks above (C4, C5, C12, C14) are different facilities. C8 runs a few metres past each end and carries no other City trail record.
OSM sidewalk C1 within 0.44 m along all 139 m.

C3 way/880560635 is a tunnel=yes sidewalk at a steady 1.0 m along the whole underpass record with a similar length (21.9 m vs 17.4 m) and no other City records. C1 way/880560627 only meets the record's end 1.

OSM sidewalk C9 way/967150044 runs parallel along the whole record at about 0.8 m, on the same side of Fife Ave and with about the same length. The only other City records on it are short corner stubs, so one_to_one.
C5 way/880816974 is the same-side Guelph Street sidewalk, 1.1 m away along the whole record; the opposite-side sidewalk C6 is 13 m away. C5 also carries City sidewalk 11933 (146.9 m).

OSM sidewalk C19 way/881240035 runs along the whole record at about 0.9 m and has almost the same length (73.5 m vs 69.6 m). The only other City records on it are 1-2 m stubs at the ends, so one_to_one.
OSM sidewalk C12 way/881239981 follows the whole record about 1 m away on the same side of Park Street and is nearly the same length; the other City records on it are corner stubs under 2 m.
C8 way/871786946 is the same-side Glasgow Street sidewalk at a median 0.9 m over 95% of the record, of similar length (87.7 m vs 92.2 m), and carries no other City records.
OSM sidewalk C1 within 1.0 m along all 226 m.
OSM sidewalk C8 way/864845385 follows the whole record at 0.2-2.5 m on the same side of King St W and is the only sidewalk there. It also carries City sidewalks 12114 and 308977, so many_to_one.
OSM sidewalk C1 within 1.4 m, 172 m against 169 m.
C5 way/374643213 (highway=path, 37.7 m) follows the walkway at a median 0.4 m. The Weber Street West cycleway C6, about 4 m away, is a different facility and carries the City's BMUT records.
OSM sidewalk C1 at a steady 0.65 m, carrying this record and sidewalk 12287.

OSM sidewalk C22 way/884265010 carries the record at about 0.8 m but stops about 7 m short of its SW end, where sidewalk C10 way/880560464 carries the last ~10 m to the corner. C22 also carries the 22 m City sidewalk 12424, so many_to_many.
OSM sidewalk C10 way/788225157 follows the record at a median 0.1 m on the same side of Queen Street North; the way continues and also carries City sidewalk 12433.
OSM sidewalk C1 runs parallel at a steady 0.43 m and carries eleven City records.

OSM splits the left-side David Street sidewalk in two: C31 way/869904100 covers the southern ~95 m from end 1 and C16 way/182031734 the northern ~150 m to end 2, both parallel and within 2 m. C16's only other City record is a 1.3 m junction stub; C19 is the opposite-side sidewalk 10 m away.

OSM sidewalk C14 way/864845565 runs along the whole record at about 0.4 m on the same side of Queen St S. The way continues over City sidewalk 13423, so many_to_one; the driveways and crossings only touch the record.
OSM sidewalk C1 at a steady 1 m, carrying this record and sidewalk 15764.

The City records stairs, but OSM has no highway=steps here, only footway C1 way/146313339 running through the stair's location 1.1 m away. The footway may stand in for the walkway including the stair, but it is not tagged as a stair, so the stair itself cannot be named with confidence.

OSM footway C2 way/146313339 lies on the walkway at 0.3 m along its whole length. C2 is 221 m and also carries other City walkway records such as 389902, so many_to_one. C4 is the sidewalk the walkway ends at.
OSM sidewalk C1 within 1.2 m, 86 m against 77 m.
OSM sidewalk C1 at a steady 0.9 m, carrying this record and sidewalk 15730.
OSM sidewalk C14 way/959971948 follows the record 0.8 m away along its full 530 m on the same side of Gage Avenue; the 747 m way also carries City sidewalk 426624.

C14 way/884960141 is the same-side Cedar Street South sidewalk within 1.7 m along the whole record, of similar length (130 m vs 129 m); its other City records are 1.6-3.8 m junction stubs. C34 is a cycleway 5 m away on the other side of the road.
OSM sidewalk C9 way/839910531 lies within 0.7 m of the whole record on the same side of King St E. It also carries City sidewalk 13364, so many_to_one.
OSM sidewalk C1 at a steady 0.7 m. OSM cycleway C2, 1.7 m away, is a different facility (the City's cycle track 394778), which closeness alone would not tell apart.
C23 way/962754932 is the same-side Borden Avenue North sidewalk, a median 1.2 m away and about the same length (184 m vs 186 m); the only other City record on it is a 2.2 m end stub.
OSM sidewalk C8 way/967153309 runs along the whole record at 0.24 m and has nearly the same length (198 m vs 193 m). The only other City record on it is a 2.3 m stub at the end, so one_to_one.
OSM sidewalk C17 way/1134382401 follows the record at a median 0.2 m and is nearly the same length; only corner stubs under 3 m share the way.
OSM sidewalk C1 within 1.1 m, 72.7 m against 69.2 m.

C16 way/962754861 is the same-side Pandora Avenue North sidewalk within 1.3 m along the whole record. It continues past Duke Street and also carries City sidewalk 14796 (131 m), so OSM merges two City records.
OSM sidewalk C11 way/962754831 runs along the whole record at under 1 m on the same side of Pandora Ave N, with nearly the same length. Only a 1 m corner stub also touches it, so one_to_one.
OSM sidewalk C1 within 0.9 m, carrying this record and sidewalk 14270.

The north part of the record lies on same-side sidewalk C7 way/886364670 (0.3 m). Where the sidewalk branches toward the rail crossing, the south part follows the short sidewalk C8 way/886364671 (its end is 0.01 m from C8). C7 also carries City sidewalks 384541 and 15766.
OSM sidewalk C14 way/886364611 runs along the whole record at 0.74 m. It continues south over the 29.9 m City sidewalk 308954, so many_to_one.

OSM sidewalk C13 way/134493384 follows the record 0.6 m away and is the same length. Cycleway C45, 4.5 m away, is the City's separated bike lane, a different facility; the other City sidewalk records on C13 are short stubs.
OSM sidewalk C1 within 1.0 m along all 240 m.
C17 way/959971809 is the same-side Belmont Avenue West sidewalk at a steady 0.2 m along the whole record (83 m vs 73 m). Its other City records are junction stubs of 1-5.5 m at the two ends.

OSM sidewalk C12 way/965483124 carries most of the record at about 1 m. The record's east end runs about 12 m past C12's end along the continuing same-side sidewalk C11 way/965483123, which also carries City sidewalk 16278, so both are cited as many_to_many.
OSM sidewalk C1 within 1.0 m, carrying this record and sidewalk 16340.
C13 way/961180337 is the same-side Weichel Street sidewalk, a median 0.7 m away along 99% of the record. It continues on to carry City sidewalk 16356 (95.3 m).
OSM sidewalk C14 way/1025420473 runs along the whole record at 0.57 m. It is 555 m long and also carries City sidewalk 311450, so many_to_one.
OSM sidewalk C10 way/1025429438 follows the record at a median 0.7 m on the north side of Overlea Drive; the 457 m way also carries City sidewalks 16636 and 16651.

C7 way/970530577 is the same-side Perth Road sidewalk at a median 0.5 m over 89% of the record. The record's west ~20 m, between the C6 driveway and Burnside Avenue, has no OSM sidewalk. C7 carries only a 2.1 m junction stub besides this record.
OSM sidewalk C15 way/969450983 follows the whole record at about 0.2 m on the same side of Kehl St. It also carries City sidewalks 16852 and 389963, so many_to_one.

Footway C1 way/147000141 follows the whole walkway at under 1.4 m and is nearly the same length. The other City records on it are short junction stubs (4.6 m and 4.3 m) and a virtual link, which are not counted.
OSM footway C1 (source=Bing) within 2.6 m. The City's stairs 389865 at its end match OSM steps C2.
OSM sidewalk C12 way/967450738 runs along the whole record at 0.86 m. It is 269 m long and also carries City sidewalks 16923 and 16916, so many_to_one.
OSM sidewalk C1 within 0.7 m, carrying this record and sidewalk 396679.

The only OSM element is footway C1 way/116233513. It follows the stair 0.5 m away but is tagged highway=footway, not highway=steps, and runs 80 m over several City walkway records. It may be the same walkway with the stair unmapped, so I cannot name a stair element with confidence.
OSM sidewalk C1 within 1.5 m along all 716 m; both sources carry the crescent's sidewalk as one piece.
OSM sidewalk C1 at a steady 0.77 m, 78.5 m against 75.1 m.
C11 way/1070830237 is the same-side Stonybrook Drive sidewalk at a steady 0.6-1.2 m along the whole record, of the same length (75.5 m vs 74.1 m), and carries no other City records.

OSM footway C1 way/116233514 lies on the stair's line at 0.2 m over its whole length and also carries the adjoining City walkways 403918 and 403919, so many_to_one. OSM tags this way highway=footway rather than steps; that is an attribute difference, which these labels do not judge.
One OSM way carries both of the court's sidewalks round the end: 17527 (right) and this record (left), within 1.1 m.
OSM footway C1 within 0.6 m, 61.1 m against 60.1 m.
C16 way/965483166 is the same-side Spadina Road West sidewalk, 1.1 m away along the whole record and about the same length (33.4 m vs 32.0 m); the other City records on it are end stubs under 5 m.

OSM has no sidewalk on this side of Perth Road: the road C5 way/970530575 is tagged sidewalk=no, and the nearest footway (C4 way/970530574, 5.1 m away and perpendicular) belongs to another street. No correspondence.
OSM sidewalk C12 way/902534671 follows the record at a median 0.3 m over essentially the same 87 m on the same side of St. Vincent Street; only corner stubs under 3 m share it.

A sidewalk the City records as installed in 2024 (2025 orthoimagery), with new curb-cut stubs at both ends, along the east side of Lawrence Avenue. OSM has only the road (no sidewalk tags) and the west-side sidewalk C6, 12 m away.

OSM sidewalk C1 lies within 1.0 m along the record but runs 21 m on past the City's dead end and turns to meet the end of the Stirling Avenue North stub. Partial overlap; coverage difference: OSM's join to the road.

C5 way/37891916 (Trans Canada Trail, foot and bicycle designated path) runs at a steady 1.7 m along the whole underpass under the Conestoga Parkway bridge. The 716 m way also carries the adjoining City BMUT records 52249 and 5197 and others.
One side of a small trail-junction triangle: OSM path C1 (surface=compacted, smoothness=intermediate) within 3.1 m, with the City's ends shifted about 3 m along it.

OSM path C4 way/666126727 is tagged bridge=yes and lies on the record at about 0.4 m, with the same length (22.1 m against 22.5 m). Only the 3.4 m City trail stub 7803 at the junction also touches it, so one_to_one.
Footway C5 way/846776251 matches the MUT almost exactly (median 0.4 m, 34.3 m vs 32.8 m) and carries no other City record. C4 is a 3 m stub at the end.
OSM steps C2 way/134137778 lie on the stair at a median 0.41 m and have nearly the same length (10.7 m vs 11.2 m). Footways C9-C12 only meet its ends, so one_to_one.

OSM cycleway C5 way/85540855 (bridge=yes, foot=designated) carries the MUT across the bridge at a steady 1.3 m. It runs only about 4 m past each end, over the adjoining City MUT pieces 8086 and 7318; that is within junction end slop, so I treat it as one_to_one.

C4 way/503459341 is a 3.9 m Iron Horse Trail cycleway segment within 1.3 m of the whole 3.0 m record, with no other City records. The C1 bridge cycleway starts at the record's east end, and C2/C5 are 2-5 m away.

The Iron Horse Trail way C1 way/960971553 runs along the record at 0.02 m and continues over City MUT records 5110, 55508 and 55509, so many_to_one. OSM has no tunnel tag on this stretch, but this trail way is the element that carries the facility through the structure.
OSM path C1 lies within 1.3 m along the whole record; it also carries the City's MUT 44906.
Footway C1 way/144265688 carries the path across the City's bridge section at a median 0.4 m, though it has no bridge tag. It also carries the adjoining City MUT records 12248, 61822 and 7912.

The curb-cut piece lies along the last metres of OSM path C2 way/1119075367, where it runs down to Huck Crescent (all within 1 m, at 10 deg). There is no kerb node within 8 m, and sidewalk C3 only touches its end. C2 also carries City MUT 46583, so many_to_one.

The record is a 5.6 m dead-end trail spur running north from the west end of OSM path C1 way/1131094438. C1 only touches its south end, at a right angle (86.6 deg), and OSM draws nothing along the spur.
C1 way/34106846 is the Henry Sturm Trail tunnel=yes cycleway at a steady 1.0 m through the whole underpass. The 73 m way also carries the adjoining City MUT records 7789 and 88143.
OSM path C6 way/230975613 lies along the whole record at about 0.3 m and continues over the next City MUT, 7812, so many_to_one. Paths C1 and C4 only meet the record's west end.

The Lakeside Park MUT. OSM path C1 (source=survey) carries its east 70% and continues south over the City's MUT 47693; OSM path C2 carries its west end. 90% of the record lies within 2 m of one or the other.
OSM path C1 (foot and bicycle designated, source=Bing) within 1.4 m, 165.6 m against 155.5 m.

The end of Community Trail path C6 way/194416965 carries most of this 13.7 m connector (69% within 2 m). The record then diverges from it at about 20 degrees, crosses Henry Sturm Trail C5 way/194224544 and ends about 6 m from C6, in the C2/C3/C5 junction. Whether C6 alone represents it, or C3 way/25947685 and C5 do too, is unclear.

OSM cycleway C5 way/765839602 (foot=designated) lies on the underpass trail at 0.04 m and covers the same stretch (29 m vs 18.6 m). It has no tunnel tag, which is an attribute and is not judged here. C3 only touches an end, so one_to_one.
OSM footway C3 way/918858152 (bridge=yes, surface=wood) carries the trail across the same small bridge 0.8 m away and is about the same length. The approach footways C2 and C5 only touch its ends.
OSM traffic-island footway between the two crossings of Ottawa Street South, within 1.8 m; the City's BMUT island segment links two crossrides the same way.

There is no kerb node within 8 m. The 3.0 m curb-cut piece lies along C10 way/969454668, a 2.2 m sidewalk stub (100% within 1.5 m, parallel) leading to the C11 crossing way/969454669. C11 only begins at the piece's end, and the C14/C5 ways cross the piece at right angles.

OSM sidewalk C7 way/1025420443 (bridge=yes, layer=1) runs along the whole overpass record at about 0.5 m, with a similar length. The only other City record on it is an on-road bicycle lane, a different facility, so one_to_one.

C15 way/1131094328 is the same-side Falconridge Drive sidewalk, a median 0.9 m away along the whole record and about the same length (144 m vs 142 m); the other City records on it are short end stubs.

OSM crossing way C8 way/1131094317 crosses Woolwich Street at 0.73 m and has the same length (11.4 m vs 11.0 m). Its crossing node is not cited because a crossing way exists. The other City records on C8 are 3 m BMUT stubs, so one_to_one.
On this east side OSM has only Woolwich Street (C2), with no sidewalk tags. The only OSM sidewalk, C4 way/1131094289, is on the opposite side about 12.7 m away.
C7 way/931860442 is the unmarked crossing of Schueller Street, within 1.9 m along the whole record and of similar length (12.0 m vs 14.0 m). Its other City records are 1.3 m and 3.0 m end stubs.

A curb cut with no kerb node within 8 m. The piece lies parallel along OSM footway C10 way/1117294611 at about 0.9 m, on the link from sidewalk C11 to crossing C9. Crossing C9 overlaps only the last metre at its east end, so C10 alone is cited; it carries no other City record.
OSM sidewalk C1 (446 m) within 0.6 m, carrying the crescent's sidewalk records. All six OSM vertices beside the record sit on City vertices with one common shift (spread 0.26 m).
A 10 m piece lying along a 1.1 km OSM sidewalk C1 (within 0.8 m) that carries eight City records.

C2 way/135654800 is the same-side Joseph Street sidewalk, a median 1.1 m away along 99% of the record and the same length (88 m vs 87 m); the other records on it are an end stub and a MUT that touches only its end.
OSM unmarked crossing of West Acres Crescent, 1.2 m median. The City records asphalt; OSM has no surface tag.
OSM sidewalk C11 way/961706842 runs along the whole record at 0.5 m. It is 331 m long and also carries other City sidewalks such as 301913 and 16735, so many_to_one.
OSM crossing way C4 way/1084117307 crosses Charles Best Place along the same line, at a median 0.6 m. The City piece runs about 4 m past its end onto sidewalk C3, which is within end slop.

C5 way/969454616 is the crossing of Pattandon Avenue at a median 0.2 m along the whole record. It extends a few metres past each end over the 3.0 m and 4.4 m City connector stubs, which are not counted.

The City crosswalk crosses Westmount Rd E on the north side of the Stonybrook Dr junction. The nearby OSM crossings C5 and C6 cross Stonybrook Drive, perpendicular to the record, and there is no crossing way or crossing node on Westmount Rd (C12) within 8 m.

This curb-cut piece runs 0.9 m from the last metres of walkway C3 way/146313339, between the sidewalk junction and the start of crossing C6. There is no kerb node within 2 m, and C4 and C6 only touch its ends. C3 also carries City walkways 389902, 13661 and others.
OSM crossing way C6 way/903234714 crosses Lang Crescent at 0.93 m and has the same length (12.6 m). Only 1-3 m sidewalk stubs share it, so one_to_one.
OSM crossing way C4 way/902534780 crosses Brunswick Avenue 0.85 m from the record and is the same length; only 1 m curb stubs share it.

C13 way/880560638 is the marked crossing of Wellington Street North at a median 0.3 m and of the same length (20.7 m vs 21.4 m). Its other City records are 1.6-2.8 m stubs. C11 crosses a different leg and carries City crosswalk 305762.
OSM unmarked crossing of Buttonwood Drive between two kerb=lowered nodes, 0.6 m median; the City's line runs 1 to 2.5 m further at each end.
The City's 2.9 m curb-cut stub is the last stretch of its walkway 16507 to the road edge; OSM's footway C1 carries both and ends on the Beechmanor Crescent centreline. No kerb node.

OSM crossing way C13 way/967150061 crosses Bruce St at about 0.66 m along the whole record. Only short corner curb pieces also lie on it, so one_to_one; the other crossings, C5 and C6, cross Fife Ave.
C6 way/884265056 is the crossing of Mansion Street at this place, a median 0.9 m away and about the same length. The other crossings (C5, C7) cross Dunham Avenue.
OSM crossing way C5 way/884264922 crosses Dunham Avenue at 0.93 m and has nearly the same length (12.2 m vs 11.4 m). Only short sidewalk stubs share it, so one_to_one.
OSM crossing way C3 way/967116491 crosses Bingeman Street 0.55 m from the record and is the same length; only curb stubs under 1 m share it.
OSM unmarked crossing (asphalt, lowered kerbs) of Brubacher Street within 1.4 m. The neighbouring OSM crossings C5 and C9 cross Samuel Street instead.
OSM marked crossing (lines, asphalt, lowered kerbs with tactile paving) within 1.4 m.

C10 way/967122745 is the unmarked crossing of Cameron Street North at a median 0.4 m, running kerb to kerb. The City crosswalk runs corner to corner, a few metres further onto the C9/C11 sidewalks, which is end slop only.

The same signalised crossing of Weber Street East at Cameron Street North. Both start at the north-east corner; the City's crosswalk lands 6 m further west on the south-west corner, where OSM's C1 stops at a kerb=lowered node.
OSM crossing way C5 way/1119075465 crosses Lynnvalley Cres within 0.4 m of the whole record, with the same length, so one_to_one.
Crossing way C4 way/1120245084 crosses Jacqueline Place at a steady 1.0 m from the record and is the same length (10.0 m vs 9.8 m). The only other City record on it is a 2.2 m curb-cut stub.

The record crosses Courtland Avenue East on the west side of Cedar Street, but OSM has no crossing way or crossing node over Courtland there. The nearby crossings C7 way/884960159 and C9 way/884960171 cross Cedar Street, a different road. No correspondence.
The City crosswalk crosses Benton Street. The nearby OSM crossings C8 and C11 cross St. George Street, a different road, and OSM has no crossing way or crossing node on Benton Street here.

Kerb node 8241884424 (kerb=lowered, 0.5 m) marks the ramp where the C5 crossing way/886364606 (City crosswalk 308966) leaves the corner. The piece lies on C11 way/1377306796, the 0.8 m sidewalk stub from that kerb to the junction with C3 sidewalk way/886364604 (City sidewalk 12130).
OSM signalised crossing way C7 way/739451229 crosses Victoria St S within 0.9 m of the whole record, with the same length. Only short curb pieces also lie on it, so one_to_one.
OSM has only the roads here, Guelph Street C2 (sidewalk=no) and Riverbend Drive C1. There is no crossing way and no crossing node within 8 m of this crosswalk.
OSM sidewalk C5 way/212553251 runs along the whole record at 0.2 m and has the same length (139.6 m vs 139.5 m). The cycle paths near its south end are a different facility, so one_to_one.
OSM's marked, signalised crossing of both Fischer-Hallman carriageways is one way, within 0.7 m; the City splits it at the median into 311117 and 401921.

The 1 m curb-cut piece sits where sidewalks C4 and C8 and crossings C9 (the City's crosswalk 297702) and C5 meet at one untagged OSM junction. No kerb node lies within 8 m and the piece follows none of the ways, so I cannot say which element represents it.

The 1.4 m corner connector cuts diagonally, at 40-50 degrees, across the untagged junction where the C4 sidewalk way/903270487 meets the C6 crossing way/903270489. There is no kerb node, so OSM collapses the piece into the junction and neither way can be named alone.

The kerb=lowered node/8389113634, 0.9 m away, marks this ramp where crossing C6 begins. The piece lies along the last 2.5 m of sidewalk C7 way/903234715, which also carries City sidewalk 10443, so many_to_one. Crossing C6 only touches the piece's end.

kerb=lowered node/8386062330, 0.65 m away, marks where crossing C4 leaves this corner. The piece lies along the first segment of sidewalk C6 way/902902656 (median 0.4 m), from that kerb to the corner. C6 also carries City sidewalk 10736.
A 1.2 m corner piece of the City's sidewalk network where two sidewalks and two signalised crossings meet. OSM draws no piece, just the junction, with a kerb=lowered node 0.3 m away.

This 1.3 m curb cut sits at the corner where OSM sidewalks C3 way/880560544 and C5 way/880560554 meet, and it cuts across them at 50-70 deg instead of following either. The only kerb node, node/8382784263 at the start of crossing C6, is 3.3 m away, beyond the ~2 m rule, so the elements cannot be named with confidence.

OSM draws no stub. Kerb node 8192888268 (kerb=lowered), 1.0 m away where crossing C5 leaves sidewalk C4, marks this ramp; C5 carries the City crosswalk 305285 that the piece touches. It is the only kerb node within 8 m.

Kerb node 8192888363 (kerb=lowered, 0.55 m) marks this ramp. The 2.6 m piece straddles it, parallel: about 1.2 m along the last metres of the C6 sidewalk way/880864072 (also City sidewalk 11959) and 1.4 m along the first metres of the C7 crossing way/880864087 (also City crosswalk 305251).

principle.correspondence_is_physical: A label says which OSM elements are the same physical facility as the City record. It never judges whether either source is right about the facility's attributes. Physical correspondence and attribute agreement are separate questions: OSM describing the facility more generally than the City (a plain footway where the City records a stair) is an attribute difference, not by itself a reason for ambiguity.

correspondence.obvious_correspondence: OSM represents the same physical facility, and the labeller can name exactly which OSM elements, with no reasonable alternative. Closeness alone never qualifies: the element must be the same facility in the same place — the same side of the road, the same crossing, the same flight of stairs.
correspondence.ambiguous_correspondence: OSM may represent it, but the elements cannot be named with confidence: two equally plausible ways; a short piece at a corner or junction that follows no single way (including a curb cut there with no kerb node); two kerb nodes when it cannot be told which marks this ramp; OSM steps nearby that may be the same stair drawn elsewhere; a way under construction; or a facility OSM records only as a tag on a road.
correspondence.no_correspondence: Nothing in OSM represents this facility: no way or node of the same kind within about 5 m. A road alone is not a correspondence for a sidewalk unless it tags one, and a way that only touches one end of the record at an angle is not one.
correspondence.not_comparable: The record cannot be judged, for example a broken geometry.

osm.ways: Every OSM way that carries the same facility over any part of the record, including a way that runs far beyond it. Not ways that only touch its ends: about a junction's width (5 m) of the record onto the next way is end slop, not a second way.
osm.crossings: The crossing way over the same road at the same place; if OSM has no crossing way there but a highway=crossing node where the City's crossing is, the node.
osm.curb_cuts: For a CURBCUT = Y record: the OSM kerb node (barrier=kerb or kerb=*) that marks this ramp, if one lies within about 2 m of the piece; and every OSM way the piece follows — most of it within about 2 m, running in line with the way, not across it. A crossing way counts exactly like a sidewalk: a piece running from the end of a sidewalk onto the first metres of a crossing follows both. With two kerb nodes near, cite the one where the crossing the piece runs onto begins; if the piece serves both crossings or you cannot tell, ambiguous. With no kerb node and no way the piece follows — it sits across a junction — ambiguous. A curb cut is local: never cite a way for a curb cut because the piece touches it. CURBCUT = Y does not say kerb=lowered or kerb=flush; the kerb value is not judged.
osm.stairs: The OSM ways that are the same flight of stairs. If OSM tags it highway=steps, cite those. If OSM draws the same stair as a plain footway or path — same place, same line, same connections, no highway=steps near — cite that way: an obvious correspondence, representation generic_way. If a highway=steps way lies nearby but not on the record, it may be the same stair drawn elsewhere: ambiguous. Also ambiguous: several plausible ways, topology that disagrees, or an unclear split or merge.
osm.structures: Bridges, overpasses, underpasses and boardwalks: every OSM way that carries the same facility over any part of the record, including approach ways the City record runs along. If none is tagged as the structure (bridge=*, tunnel=*), the representation is generic_way.
osm.corner_and_junction_pieces: A piece of a few metres (not a curb cut) at a corner or junction: obvious only if it clearly follows one way. If it lies between two ways that meet at the corner, or across the junction at an angle, ambiguous.
osm.construction: An OSM way tagged highway=construction is not a current facility; if it is the only candidate, the correspondence is ambiguous.
osm.ambiguous: For an ambiguous correspondence, the plausible alternatives, for the record.

representation.separate_way: Only ways are cited, and at least one is the City's kind of facility.
representation.generic_way: Only ways are cited, and none carries the City's structure type: a City stair on a way not tagged highway=steps; a City bridge, overpass, underpass or boardwalk on ways with no bridge=* or tunnel=* tag.
representation.road_attribute: OSM records the facility only as a tag on a road.

relationship.one_to_one: The record and one OSM way cover substantially the same extent, and that way carries no other physical City record of the same facility. A node-only correspondence.
relationship.one_to_many: The record corresponds to several OSM ways: OSM splits it.
relationship.many_to_one: The OSM way also carries other physical City records of the same facility: OSM merges what the City splits.
relationship.many_to_many: Several records and several ways, with no clean nesting.
relationship.not_counted: Virtual links and connector stubs of a few metres at a junction are not counted; about a junction's width (5 m) of end slop is not a difference in extent.
